reference.pathophysiology: Monitored theatre arrests shock early with roles rotating compressions while suxamethonium bradycardia, chlorhexidine anaphylaxis and bupivacaine LAST each carry their antidote; tamponade opens chests and concealed bleeds switch massive on, and ROSC debriefs with DATIX candour.
additionalDifferentials: Anaphylaxis versus LAST versus bleed versus tamponade by tryptase seizures drains and echo
VF versus bradycardia versus asystole by pads drugs and pacing
Theatre versus ward by monitors roles and sterility
